Sometimes, a two-minute film can say more about love than an entire feature.

Thursday Appointment (2019) is a beautiful Iranian short film that tells a simple but deeply moving story about love, kindness, and the people we carry with us even after they’re gone.

Set on the busy streets of Tehran, the film follows an elderly man whose small act of kindness toward a struggling family becomes something much more meaningful. Inspired by Persian poetry, it reminds us that love doesn’t disappear when someone is no longer beside us.

There’s very little dialogue, no complicated storytelling, and nothing unnecessary. Just a simple moment that leaves you thinking long after it’s over.

Written and directed by Mohammad Reza Kheradmandan, the film is a lovely example of how much emotion can fit into just a couple of minutes.

* Written, directed and edited by Mohammad Reza Kheradmandan
* Produced by Mohammad Reza Shafah
* Cinematography by Ahad Agheli

Thursday Appointment (2019) — Iran.
